authors: Nguyen Hung Tran, TokenVector Compiler Engineering Team
description: TokenVector.Inference - the inference runtime and GPT-2 124M training engine written in pure TokenVector (.tkv). Graph optimization, INT8/FP8 quantization, ONNX reader, paged KV-cache, micro-batcher, and an end-to-end GPT-2 124M trainer (loss EXACT vs HF fixture, 135/135 f32 gate, full step @seq1024 on par with PyTorch). Compiled with the tkvc-tv compiler (package 'TokenVector').
releaseNotes: v1.0.1 - 2026-11-11: GPT-2 124M full train step @seq1024 = 4016 ms vs torch 4061.1 (0.989x, same session); loss EXACT; gate_f32 135/135; trainer 15/15; gpt2_full 33/33; request #14; ships a managed assembly TokenVector.Inference.dll (net10.0, built from the .tkv sources) with a dependency on the 'TokenVector' package (compiler + native runtime).
summary: Pure .tkv inference runtime and GPT-2 124M training engine for the TokenVector ecosystem.
title: TokenVector.Inference - Pure .tkv Inference Runtime & GPT-2 124M Training Engine
